scripts.pages:dev: vite build && npx wrangler pages dev dist --port 8788
scripts.db:migrate: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply doctor-db --remote
scripts.db:migrate:local: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply doctor-db --local
scripts.db:fresh: npm run db:reset && npm run db:migrate && npm run seed:remote
scripts.db:fresh:local: npm run db:reset:local && npm run db:migrate:local && npm run seed
